PreToolUse.description: Inject ontology domain context when editing any file tracked in .claude/ontology/index.json. Resolves from the git root so the hook still works when Codex starts in a subdirectory. Zero-cost when no match.

Inject QA bug history context when editing files with known issues from previous /qa-loop runs. Resolves from the git root so the hook still works when Codex starts in a subdirectory. Zero-cost when no match.
